summary: Phase 1 wallet ledger rebuild fixes verified end-to-end. 13/13 backend pytest cases passed and all frontend checks (5 wallet cards, 3 relabeled buttons, 3 step modals with correct titles + banners, Record Crypto TX modal with received_wallet dropdown + Treasury Movement link) passed.
critical_code_review_comments: wallets.service.ts pickWalletForGateway correctly defaults unknown gateways to OKX (line ~327); WALLETS array has the expected 5 codes only.

recharges.service.ts addCryptoTx now accepts received_wallet override and properly routes the deposit ledger row to the chosen wallet; 400 still returned when neither receiving_wallet nor received_wallet is provided.
webhooks.service.ts telegram_manual defaults gateway to 'Binance' as required.
expenses.service.ts pickWallet routes Card/Cash → WIO_BANK with no MANUAL fallback.

WalletLedger.jsx renders all 3 new step modals with explicit copy ('Step 1 · Transfer Crypto Between Wallets', 'Step 2 · Convert Coin Inside Wallet', 'Step 3 · Withdraw AED to Wio Bank') and matching guidance banners.

RechargeDetail.jsx 'Record Crypto TX' modal has a 'Received In Wallet' dropdown with all 5 wallet codes plus separate Coin + Network fields; old 'OKX / Wio Step' button replaced by a /wallets Link as expected.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_0xphase1_* customers, recharges, invoices, expenses, send-batch/convert/cashout ledger rows. Cleanup not automated — recommend purging rows tagged 0xphase1_* / TEST_ prefix after this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 acceptance criteria from the brief are met. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_wallets.py can be reused as regression for Phase 2. Telegram-manual webhook lives at POST /api/webhooks/telegram-manual (not /telegram) and requires header x-axistra-webhook-secret = PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET; payload must use amount+currency (not amount_aed) and status='paid' to trigger recharge creation. The 9 ETH that migrated from MANUAL to OKX is confirmed present on OKX/ETH (>=9.0). Wallet ledger UI uses Modal with title strings 'Step 1 · ...', 'Step 2 · ...', 'Step 3 · ...' and the 'Cancel' button closes the modal (Escape was unreliable). Record Crypto TX dropdown options = ['BINANCE','OKX','OXAPAY','BTCPAY','WIO_BANK'].
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — verification iteration; no bugs detected.
